$comment: The axe register (14 §3): every UI-### screen, the addresses it lives at, and the spec that scans it. Nothing here is authoritative on its own — ./coverage.test.ts re-derives the id set from docs/tech/COVERAGE.md, the names from 16 §8.2, the routes from the app router on disk, and the spec from COVERAGE.md's own Tests column, and fails when this file disagrees with any of them. A screen that is not built yet carries `pending` with the build-plan step that builds it, and is checked to be still unbuilt so the marker cannot be left behind.

unregisteredRoutes.reason: 09 §1: `/` is a signpost, not a screen — it renders nothing and redirects to /home or /sign-in, so there is no document for axe to read.
UI-050's screens are /admin/users, /admin/flags and /admin/audit; the bare prefix renders nothing and redirects to the first of them, so there is no document for axe to read.
